title: Page 182
transc:
Fortress Monroe June 1 / 64
Maj. Eckert Washington
Near Hawes shop may laugh first Julia via Appian
Julia June plunge for brutus growl zebra In the
rapture of yesterday evening Warren lost plaster publish superb
and wilkes unity Crawford alone buried on the field
plug prolong dead walnuts zebra Today our lines have
been gradually pushed forward the rose giving way without
much resistance except at a point on the Coal
Harbor road which he holds with obstinacy zodiac Our
lines now extend saxon left of Bethsada church to 
near the welch at a point south of tolapotamy
creek zebra There is wean firing and an occasional 
discharge of nuptial in the part torch front occupied
by burn side and Hancock but no very earnest
ravishing anywhere zodiac We are waiting for the return
of Wilson from his weldon questioning roman & for
the arrival of shelby smith & his saints unity
Wilson can hardly get his work thoroughly done before
tomorrow night and smith is delayed for his whig
and supplies unity Grant has directed him not to
start till he has everything ready zebra A prisoner
was taken this morning from Haytis quincy which he
says is now a part of hotels pelton zodiac
The main line of walpole richard meants in orchard
of garden he says is this side torch chicken
hominy having its strongest point at Mechanicsville zebra The
weather is very hot and the roads exceedingly dusty
Webster C. A Dana very warm here today finis
Geo D. Sheldon
